# Data dictionary

**All data are synthetic.** They are generated by `src/risk_model/synth.py` from `data/params.json` (seed, intensity, size); no real applicant or company is involved. `data/sample_applications.csv` is a 2,000-row sample; `python -m risk_model.synth --full` writes the full 80,000 rows to `data/applications.csv` (git-ignored).

| column | meaning |
|---|---|
| `month` | application month 0-23 (0-13 train, 14-17 validation, 18-23 out-of-time test) |
| `age` | years |
| `income` | monthly income, EUR |
| `tenure` | months in current job |
| `temp_contract` | 1 = temporary contract |
| `amount`, `term` | loan amount (EUR) and term (months) |
| `dti` | debt-to-income ratio |
| `has_bank` | 1 = bank data linked (inflow and overdraft are empty otherwise: structural missingness) |
| `bank_inflow`, `bank_overdraft` | monthly inflow (EUR) and overdraft intensity from linked bank data |
| `inquiries`, `hist_len`, `prev_loans` | recent credit inquiries, months of credit history, previous loans |
| `channel`, `device`, `hour` | acquisition channel (seo, sem_marca, sem_generico, afiliados, directo), device (movil, escritorio) and application hour |
| `form_secs`, `email_free` | seconds spent on the form, 1 = free email domain |
| `lti`, `pti`, `inflow_ratio` | derived: amount/income, instalment/income, bank inflow/income |
| `y` | default flag (target) |

Category labels `movil`, `escritorio`, `sem_marca`, ... are kept in Spanish because the prototype UI is Spanish; the paper translates them.
